name: Haloperidol decanoate
summary: Haloperidol decanoate, sold under the brand name Haldol Decanoate among others, is a typical antipsychotic which is used in the treatment of schizophrenia. It is administered by injection into muscle at a dose of 100 to 200 mg once every 4 weeks or monthly. The dorsogluteal site is recommended.5-inch) needle to ensure that the drug is indeed injected intramuscularly and not subcutaneously.

uses.text: Haloperidol decanoate, sold under the brand name Haldol Decanoate among others, is a typical antipsychotic which is used in the treatment of schizophrenia. A 3.75-cm (1.5-inch), 21-gauge needle is generally used, but obese individuals may require a 6.5-cm (2.5-inch) needle to ensure that the drug is indeed injected intramuscularly and not subcutaneously.
uses.brands: Halomonth, Haldol Decanoate, Haldol Decanoas, Haloperidol Decanoate, Haloperidol Decanoat, Neoperidole, Serenase Dekanoat

pharmacology.en: After injection it leaks slowly from the oil into the blood, where enzymes split off the fatty acid to release haloperidol. Haloperidol strongly blocks dopamine D2 receptors.
pharmacology.zh: 注射後它從油劑中緩慢滲入血液，酵素切除脂肪酸後釋出氟哌啶醇。氟哌啶醇會強力阻斷多巴胺 D2 受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 注射后它从油剂中缓慢渗入血液，酵素切除脂肪酸后发布氟哌啶醇。氟哌啶醇会强力阻断多巴胺 D2 受体。

sideEffects.en: It shares the side effects of haloperidol: stiffness, tremor, restlessness, drowsiness and raised prolactin. Long-term use can cause tardive dyskinesia, a lasting movement disorder, and rare serious risks include neuroleptic malignant syndrome and heart rhythm problems. Because it is long acting, side effects can last a while after an injection.
sideEffects.zh: 它的副作用與氟哌啶醇相同：肌肉僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安、嗜睡和泌乳素升高。長期使用可能造成遲發性運動障礙這種持久的動作問題，少見但嚴重的風險包括抗精神病藥惡性症候群和心律問題。由於作用時間長，注射後副作用可能持續一段時間。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的副作用与氟哌啶醇相同：肌肉僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安、嗜睡和泌乳素升高。长期使用可能造成迟发性运动障碍这种持久的动作问题，少见但严重的风险包括抗精神病药恶性症候群和心律问题。由于作用时间长，注射后副作用可能持续一段时间。

fact.en: Attaching decanoic acid, a ten-carbon fatty acid whose name comes from the Greek deka for ten, makes haloperidol oily, so an injection forms a slow-release store in the muscle.
fact.zh: 接上癸酸（十碳脂肪酸，名稱源自希臘文 deka，意為「十」）後，氟哌啶醇會變得油溶性，注射後在肌肉中形成緩慢釋放的儲存庫。
fact.zhHans: 接上癸酸（十碳脂肪酸，名称源自希腊文 deka，意为「十」）后，氟哌啶醇会变得油溶性，注射后在肌肉中形成缓慢释放的保存库。
